channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Pesquisa Lula x Flávio segundo turno: veja os números atualizados de hoje
item.description: Today's (24th) polls for the runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) show a technical tie, with variations within the margin of error. The race remains tight, reflecting the electorate's polarization. Voting intentions suggest a close election in 2026.

item.title: Sem ir a eventos de Flávio, Michelle participa último ato de campanha no DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro participated in the final campaign rally of the second round in the Federal District alongside Governor Celina Leão. During the campaign period, she did not attend any events with Flávio Bolsonaro. The event included a walk through Brasília with the local governor.

item.title: Veja o resultado das últimas pesquisas para governador em 5 estados e no DF
item.description: Recent polls in six states and the Federal District reveal the electoral landscape ahead of gubernatorial runoff elections, focusing on voter behavior in Acre, Amazonas, Brasília, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Norte, and Tocantins. The surveys highlight competitive races and uncertainty around definitive outcomes.

item.title: Quem está na frente das pesquisa hoje, véspera do 2ş turno? Veja levantamentos
item.description: Surveys ahead of the 2026 runoff show a tight race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with differences within the margin of error. No candidate leads clearly.

item.title: Flávio na pesquisa para presidente: veja últimos números do segundo turno
item.description: Surveys released on the eve of the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff showed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) numerically ahead of Lula (PT), within the margin of error. The race remains tight, with no clear frontrunner between the two candidates.

item.title: Como último estado do Nordeste com 2º turno deve votar para Presidência, segundo pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey reveals that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 63% of valid votes in Rio Grande do Norte, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secures 37%. The approval rating of Lula's government in the state is 61%, based on a poll with a two-percentage-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, renda e religião na véspera da eleição
item.description: A Quaest poll released before the Brazilian 2026 runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 51% and Lula (PT) at 49% of valid votes. The survey interviewed 3,702 voters between October 23 and 24, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Segments analyzed include region, gender, age, political identification, income, and religion.

item.title: Em último ato antes do segundo turno, Grass pede "voto com consciência"
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) closed his DF gubernatorial campaign with a call for conscientious voting and real change for Brasília residents. At a rally on the Ministries Esplanade, Grass urged citizens to vote with love, conscience and common sense, reinforcing his ethical and grassroots governance agenda. He also sharply criticized his opponent Celina Leão (PP), emphasizing differences on rights and the role of the State.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência reúnem apoiadores no último dia de campanha
item.description: On the final day of the campaign, Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held public rallies with supporters in Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo. Flávio emphasized privatization plans and slogans like 'Fora Lula', while Lula criticized the tone of the opposing campaign and promoted dialogue. Both candidates used the events to rally voters ahead of the runoff.

item.title: USP não vai divulgar público de atos de Flávio e Lula deste sábado. Entenda
item.description: The Political Debate Monitor (USP/Cebrap) and the NGO More in Common Brazil decided not to release audience estimates for the pro-Lula and pro-Flávio events held in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, after Lula's security team blocked drone usage during the peak of the rally. The decision aims to ensure fairness between the events, preventing underestimation of the number of supporters.

item.title: Quaest: aprovação de Lula é maior que desaprovação pela 1ª vez desde agosto
item.description: Lula's approval rating rose to 48%, surpassing disapproval (45%) for the first time since August, according to a Quaest survey released ahead of the second round. Flávio Bolsonaro leads voting intentions with 51% against Lula's 49%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Quaest e Datafolha: 'muito ruim' para Lula, apesar de empate técnico; colunistas do GLOBO analisam pesquisas
item.description: Datafolha and Quaest polls show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the runoff, with 51% and 49% of valid votes respectively. GLOBO columnists suggest Lula may have reached a ceiling in growth, while Flávio holds a slight edge within the margin of error.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: veja resultado das últimas pesquisas para presidente
item.description: The latest polls for the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) show a slight numerical advantage for Flávio, within the margin of error. Surveys by Quaest, Datafolha, CNT/MDA, BTG/Nexus, and AtlasIntel reveal minimal differences, with Flávio leading by 1 to 2 percentage points in valid votes.

item.title: Nunes Marques reconsidera decisão e autoriza uso da frota de órgãos federais para transporte de indígenas no 2º turno
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, reconsidered a prior decision and authorized the use of federal fleet to transport Indigenous, Quilombola, and traditional community voters in the second round, provided each operation is previously approved by electoral judges. The PGR requested the STF to suspend this requirement, arguing that the bureaucratic procedure may hinder the access of thousands of Indigenous people to the polls on Sunday.

item.title: Bandeirão da Democracia Corintiana é levado a ato de Lula na Paulista
item.description: At his final campaign rally before the 2026 presidential runoff, Lula displayed a Corinthians flag bearing the slogan 'Democracia Corintiana,' symbolically linking football and politics. The gesture echoed the club's historical role in Brazil's redemocratization, notably Sócrates' advocacy for direct elections during the 1984 Diretas Já movement.

item.title: Lula reúne multidão na Avenida Paulista para fechar a campanha; veja imagens
item.description: Lula concluded his campaign with a major rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, labeling his opponent Flávio Bolsonaro a 'militia member' and emphasizing the need for structural changes in the country. Allies such as Geraldo Alckmin, Fernando Haddad, and Marina Silva joined the president at the event. The runoff election takes place this Sunday, October 25.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem vantagem entre eleitores mais propensos a votar
item.description: Datafolha shows that Flávio Bolsonaro leads among likely voters, with 52% against Lula's 48%. Among less likely voters, Lula takes the lead, but this group represents only 24% of the electorate.

item.title: Acompanhe a apuração do 2º turno das Eleições 2026 pelo Brasil
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections takes place this Sunday (25th), featuring a race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the presidency. Five states and the Federal District will also elect their governors. G1 provides real-time vote counting, live videos, and special resources for election coverage.

item.title: Após vídeo de Lula a Carlinhos, Flávio manda mensagem a influenciador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro recorded a video for influencer Carlinhos Maia advocating for change and criticizing Lula's government, following the influencer's declaration of uncertainty about his vote. Lula also engaged, praising Maia and requesting support for his reelection.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio vê favoritismo de candidato após Quaest e Datafolha, enquanto grupo de Lula aposta em redução de abstenção e crescimento no Nordeste
item.description: Polls released the day before the second round indicate a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with 51% and 49% of valid votes, respectively. Allies of Flávio interpret the data as a sign of favoritism, while Lula's campaign expects to reduce abstention and grow in the Northeast. Divergences reflect different assessments of the PT's wear after nearly 20 years in power.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio faz live na véspera do 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) holds his final livestream before Sunday's (Oct 25, 2026) runoff election against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The broadcast will feature a special guest yet to be announced and concludes his campaign after events in Belo Horizonte and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro encerra campanha em ato no RJ com Nikolas e Douglas Ruas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro concluded his presidential campaign with a rally in Rio de Janeiro, attended by Nikolas and Douglas Ruas. The event marked the end of public appearances ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Quaest: Vicentinho Júnior tem 59% no segundo turno do Tocantins, ante 41% de Professora Dorinha
item.description: A Quaest survey released on Saturday (24) shows deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading the Tocantins gubernatorial race with 59% of valid voting intentions, against 41% for senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil). The two candidates face off in the second round this Sunday (25).

item.title: Quaest: 48% aprovam governo Lula e 45% desaprovam
item.description: A Quaest survey released before the runoff shows that 48% of voters approve of Lula's government, compared to 45% who disapprove, marking the first time since August that approval exceeds disapproval. The survey also reveals a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in voting intentions for the second round.

item.title: Aprovação do governo, medo dos Bolsonaro, rejeição: os sinais da Quaest que mantêm a esperança de virada entre lulistas
item.description: Quaest poll released before the runoff shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45% and 46% of voting intentions respectively. Government approval for Lula rose from 46% to 48%, while rejection of Flávio dropped from 54% to 49% between October 14 and 24.

item.title: A disputa entre Flávio x Lula na capital federal, segundo pesquisa AtlasIntel na véspera do segundo turno
item.description: New AtlasIntel poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 56.9% of valid votes against Lula's 43.1% in the Federal District. Flávio's advantage is stronger among men and evangelicals, while Lula leads among young voters aged 16 to 24.

item.title: Pesquisa Globo/Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 51% dos votos válidos, e Lula, 49%
item.description: Globo/Quaest poll before runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro with 51% valid votes against Lula's 49%, within margin of error and a technical tie. Flávio leads with 46% in runoff intentions and 44% in spontaneous, while Lula has 45% and 42%. Both campaigns show high rejection rates at 49% and 47% of respondents.

item.title: Quaest: Allyson tem 51% dos votos válidos no RN, e Cadu de Lula, 49%
item.description: A Quaest poll released the day before the RN runoff shows Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) leading with 51% of valid votes, while Cadu de Lula (PT) has 49%. The gap remains within the margin of error.

item.title: Quaest: aprovação do governo Lula cresce e supera a desaprovação
item.description: Approval of Lula's government rose to 48%, surpassing disapproval at 45%, according to a Quaest poll released before the 2026 runoff. The PT administration faces Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in Sunday's election.

item.title: A distância entre Flávio e Lula nas sete principais pesquisas divulgadas na véspera do segundo turno
item.description: Seven polls released on Saturday (24) show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in voting intentions, though both are technically tied within the margins of error. The senator holds numerical advantages in all surveys, with peaks of 52% in valid votes.

item.title: Saiba quem esteve com Lula nos últimos atos antes do 2º turno
item.description: Lula concluded his campaign with events in Copacabana and Avenida Paulista, accompanied by allies such as Janja, Geraldo Alckmin, Simone Tebet, Marina Silva, Fernando Haddad, and Eduardo Paes. He lost in both states during the first round. The second round will be held on Sunday.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 50,5% dos votos válidos, e Lula, 49,5%
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released on October 24, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 50.5% of valid votes and Lula (PT) with 49.5%, technically tied due to a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Ana Maria Braga incentiva mulheres a votar: “Fuja do discurso de ódio”
item.description: Ana Maria Braga posted a video on social media encouraging women to vote in the 2026 presidential runoff, advocating for democracy, LGBTQIA+ rights, women's rights, and the fight against racism, without directly endorsing any candidate. She emphasized the importance of individual choice in voting and urged voters to review politicians' records, avoiding hate speech. Although she remained neutral, her supporters favored Lula, and the president responded positively to her post.

item.title: Marçal grava vídeo para indecisos e pede voto em Flávio
item.description: Entrepreneur Pablo Marçal (PRTB), banned from running until 2032, released a video endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and urging undecided voters to back him in the runoff to oust Lula (PT). He argues that power alternation is essential and criticizes political polarization and the lack of morality. Marçal, whose candidacy was rejected by the TSE over campaign violations, is also part of Flávio’s campaign team.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe 53% dos votos da terceira via, enquanto Lula soma 35%
item.description: The latest Quaest poll before the presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (51%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (49%), within the margin of error. Flávio leads among third-route voters, securing 53% of their votes compared to 35% for Lula. The survey also reveals that voters who cast blank or null ballots in the first round are split equally between the two candidates, while 28% remain undecided.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba o que levar na hora de votar no 2° turno
item.description: The 2026 runoff election will take place on October 25th, featuring Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as presidential candidates. Voters must bring an official ID with a photo, even if expired, and are forbidden from bringing phones or cameras into the voting booth. Paper cheat sheets and silent political expressions are allowed.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus hoje: veja números do segundo turno para Lula x Flávio
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll for 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.5% and Lula at 49.5% in the second-round vote, within a 2.2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio tem 50,5% dos votos válidos e Lula soma 49,5%, mostra pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released the day before the presidential runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 50.5% of valid votes and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 49.5%, keeping the candidates in a technical tie. Although the senator holds a slight numerical edge, the margin of error suggests the final result could be even closer.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus segundo turno: veja números de Lula x Flávio atualizados
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released on 10/24/2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the presidential runoff, with 50.5% of valid votes against 49.5%. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points, and the difference from the previous survey (10/19) is minimal.

item.title: Quantos votos Lula teve no primeiro turno? Veja resultado das Eleições 2026
item.description: Lula received 53,879,538 votes in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, securing a spot in the second round against Flávio Bolsonaro. The results were confirmed by the TSE with a 21.07% abstention rate, the highest ever recorded. The second round is scheduled for October 25th.

item.title: Pesquisa de votos para presidente: veja números de Lula x Flávio na BTG/Nexus hoje
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released today projects a tight race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential runoff, within the margin of error of 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas: Cadu de Lula tem 51,1% e Allyson, 48,9% dos votos válidos no RN
item.description: Atlas/PollsterGraph poll shows a technical tie between Cadu de Lula (PT) and Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) for RN governor, with 51.1% and 48.9% of valid votes, respectively. A two-point margin of error makes the race statistically balanced.

item.title: Milei chama Lula de “ladrão e mentiroso” ao comentar fala sobre Argentina
item.description: Argentina's President Javier Milei called Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'thief and liar' after the PT candidate claimed Argentines were eating donkey meat due to poverty. The statement followed Lula's criticism of Milei's economic model during a debate, linking it to Flávio Bolsonaro's proposals.

item.title: Atlas: Cadu (PT) tem 51,1% e Allysson (União) marca 48,9% ao governo do RN
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Cadu (PT) leading with 51.1% vs 48.9% for Allysson (União) in RN. Lula also leads presidential race with 63% vs Flávio Bolsonaro (37%). Survey of 1,780 voters with 2 point margin of error.

item.title: Ex de Janones após ir a debate: “Não é sobre vingança, nunca foi”
item.description: Leandra Guedes, mayor of Ituiutaba and former partner of André Janones, denied that her presence at the TV Globo debate was motivated by revenge, stating she speaks for women who suffer violence. Their relationship was marked by a protective measure granted in 2024 following allegations of threats and leaked intimate images, which Janones denies. While Leandra attended the debate at Flávio Bolsonaro’s invitation, Janones, who supports Lula, did not participate and held a 24-hour live stream in support of the president.

item.title: Flávio e Lula fecham campanha levando multidões para atos no RJ e em SP
item.description: Lula closed his campaign with a walk on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, while Flávio Bolsonaro ended his campaign with a rally in Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro. Both candidates mobilized crowds in simultaneous events on the eve of the runoff election. The campaign's final stretch was marked by efforts to win voters ahead of Sunday's vote.

item.title: Sistemas do TSE estão blindados contra fraudes, diz Kassio Nunes Marques
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques stated that the electoral systems are ready and protected against fraud during the Electoral Systems Verification Ceremony. The audit confirmed no changes were made to the software, ensuring vote integrity. The process is part of security protocols for the 2026 election.

item.title: Pesquisa eleitoral BTG/Nexus aponta Flávio Bolsonaro à frente no segundo turno das eleições 2026
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows a tight race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) in a potential 2026 runoff, with Bolsonaro holding a slight edge in likely voter models. Lula faces higher rejection rates, though the gap remains within the 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Vicentinho tem 59,5% dos votos válidos contra 40,5% de Dorinha no TO
item.description: A AtlasIntel survey released on October 24, 2026 shows federal deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading with 59.5% of valid voting intentions against 40.5% for Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) in the second round of the Tocantins gubernatorial race. When including blank and null votes, Vicentinho holds 53.6% and Dorinha, 36.5%, while 6.3% opted for blank or null votes. The study surveyed 1,891 voters between October 18 and 23 and is registered with the TSE under number TO-01088/2026.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Celina lidera para governo do DF com 59% dos votos válidos e Grass tem 41%, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 24, 2026, shows that the Federal District governor, Celina Leão (PP), leads the reelection race with 59% of valid votes, against 41% for PT candidate Leandro Grass. The survey, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo and TV Globo, interviewed 1620 people on October 23-24, with a ±2 point margin of error.
